derivedFrom: the decision that each denied category is refused by a marker the document carries, taken with the decision that admissibility is judged per document after the fetch and never per publisher, and with section 17's own row. Nothing here is frozen from a run. Every verdict below was written from the rules and from the marker each document states it carries, before the test that produces them was run, and the numbers the rules turn on are read back against the constants the code uses rather than restated here as figures that happen to agree.

refusedBy.a quote page carrying no article: quote or hub page with no article

documentFailingTwoGates.name: a broker marketing page with no publish date
documentFailingTwoGates.why: the kind is judged before the date, so what is stored is the statement about what the document is. Three of the five refusable pages the measurement read carried no publish date at all, so a build judging the date first would refuse most of what it refuses for the cheapest reason available and would report almost nothing about the kinds.

marketingMarkers.note: counted by hand, reading each page's text against the warnings and the kinds of invitation the rule names, each warning and each kind counted once however often it is written, so the first page's sentence carrying two of the warnings counts two. The first page carries warnings and is refused whatever its invitations, and the second carries none and is refused only by its product beside its invitations, so each half of the rule is reached by a page the fixture holds.

note: the seventh document is not a seventh kind. It is the order case, and it is the only document here that would be refused either way, so the only thing that says which rule refused it is the verdict stored on its row. The admissible half of this file is deliberately real rather than constructed: four captured articles and two release exhibits, because a test that only ever saw documents written to be refused would measure nothing about what it admits, and the admitting half is where a wrong marker costs something.
